# Quia

> > Quia is an educational platform for creating and sharing interactive learning games, quizzes, and activities for K-12 students across all subject areas.

Teachers from schools across the United States use Quia Web to build engaging educational content including battleship games, challenge boards, and Java-based activities. The platform covers subjects from elementary math and English grammar to high school chemistry and finance, with contributions from educators like Mrs. Workman, Diane Stonebrink, and Miss Garner.

## Key Topics

- Educational games and quizzes
- Battleship games
- Challenge boards
- K-12 learning activities
- English grammar and language arts
- Math education
- Science and chemistry
- Teacher-created content
- Interactive learning platform
- Capitalization and punctuation
- Verb conjugation
- ESL and language learning
- Student assessment tools
- Java Games
- Educational technology

## Platform Overview

- [Quia - Quia Web](https://www.quia.com/): Homepage for creating educational games, quizzes, and searching activities

## Language Arts Activities

- [Quia - English 8 - Cap and Punctuation](https://www.quia.com/ba/556672.html): Grade 8 English capitalization & punctuation battleship game activity
- [Quia - Word Study: Verbs ending in -x, -s, -z, -sh, -ch](https://www.quia.com/jg/1133186list.html): ESL verb conjugation study game for simple present tense endings

## Mathematics Activities

- [Quia - Second Grade Math Jeopardy #1](https://www.quia.com/cb/210522.html): Second grade math jeopardy covering addition, subtraction & place value

## Science Activities

- [Quia - 7 T3 Reactions](https://www.quia.com/cb/416857.html): Chemistry challenge board on chemical and physical reactions by Miss Garner

## Social Studies & Finance Activities

- [Quia - Finance Chapter 5 Banking](https://www.quia.com/ba/134129.html): Middle school finance battleship game covering banking chapter 5 concepts
